scenario_title: Memory leak in the program loader
title: Elevated 5xx errors on compute-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on compute-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] compute-svc 2026-06-28 18:49-18:59: compute-svc: 7 of 11 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-28 18:49 and 2026-06-28 18:59 UTC (peak error ratio 0.64 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: Call to <*> failed: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of node-svc leaks one program-image buffer per failed load; the smaller instance type from the earlier launch-template change ran out of memory first.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) drops free(image_buf) on the error path.
_templates.remediation: Roll back node-svc {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore free(image_buf) at {file}:{line}; add a leak check (valgrind) to the ppd suite.

rca.macro: Deploy v5.14.0 of node-svc leaks one program-image buffer per failed load; the smaller instance type from the earlier launch-template change ran out of memory first.
rca.micro: node/ciod/ciod_loader.c:170 (ciod_load_program) drops free(image_buf) on the error path.
rca.remediation: Roll back node-svc v5.14.0 -> v5.13.0; restore free(image_buf) at node/ciod/ciod_loader.c:170; add a leak check (valgrind) to the ppd suite.

action_items: Add a regression test covering ciod_load_program (node/ciod/ciod_loader.c).
Alert on the error signature `Call to <*> failed: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`.
